theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: This is the highest-ranked scorable theme by proxy (3033.HK) but sits at rank 13/17 with a negative score, is ineligible by the trend gate, has weak breadth (0.421), mean-revert hurst, and negative crowding. The only validated edge — drawdown avoidance via the trend gate — argues against holding it while ineligible. This is a structural avoidance, not a fade or short.
theses.dissent: China tech is deeply lagging and low-crowding in a mean-revert regime; a sharp reversal higher would represent the strongest bounce potential if a policy surprise hits.
